name: Lost Huntsman
ability: Once per game, at night, choose a player: the Off Script Damsel, if chosen, becomes a Townsfolk character. This ability works even if dead. [+the Off Script Damsel]
firstNightReminder: The Huntsman might choose a player. If they chose the Off Script Damsel: put the Huntsman to sleep. Wake the target. Show the *YOU ARE* card and a Townsfolk token.
otherNightReminder: The Huntsman might choose a player. If they chose the Off Script Damsel: put the Huntsman to sleep. Wake the target. Show the *YOU ARE* card and a Townsfolk token.

name: Off Script Damsel
ability: The Off Script Damsel is a drunk good player that registers as an Outsider. All Minions know when an Off Script Damsel is in play. Their team loses if a Minion publicly guesses them (once).
firstNightReminder: During Minion Info, show the Minions the Off Script Damsel token if it is in play.
